name: Account Holding Information V 10
definition: Scope|The AccountHoldingInformation message is sent by an executing party, for example, a (old) plan manager (transferor), to the instructing party, for example, a (new) plan manager (transferee), to provide information about financial instruments held on behalf of a client.|Usage|The AccountHoldingInformation message is used to provide information on the individual assets held in a client's account. The assets may be part of a tax efficient product, a pension of general investment product.

MessageReference.name: Message Reference
MessageReference.definition: Reference that uniquely identifies the message from a business application standpoint.

PoolReference.name: Pool Reference
PoolReference.definition: Collective reference identifying a set of messages.

PreviousReference.name: Previous Reference
PreviousReference.definition: Reference to a linked message that was previously sent.

RelatedReference.name: Related Reference
RelatedReference.definition: Reference to a linked message that was previously received.

BusinessFlowDirectionType.name: Business Flow Direction Type
BusinessFlowDirectionType.definition: Business flow direction (assets to be delivered or received).

PrimaryIndividualInvestor.name: Primary Individual Investor
PrimaryIndividualInvestor.definition: Information identifying the primary individual investor, for example, name, address, social security number and date of birth.

SecondaryIndividualInvestor.name: Secondary Individual Investor
SecondaryIndividualInvestor.definition: Information identifying the secondary individual investor, for example, name, address, social security number and date of birth.

OtherIndividualInvestor.name: Other Individual Investor
OtherIndividualInvestor.definition: Information identifying the other individual investors, for example, name, address, social security number and date of birth.

PrimaryCorporateInvestor.name: Primary Corporate Investor
PrimaryCorporateInvestor.definition: Information identifying the primary corporate investor, for example, name and address.

SecondaryCorporateInvestor.name: Secondary Corporate Investor
SecondaryCorporateInvestor.definition: Information identifying the secondary corporate investor, for example, name and address.

OtherCorporateInvestor.name: Other Corporate Investor
OtherCorporateInvestor.definition: Information identifying the other corporate investors, for example, name and address.

TransferorAccount.name: Transferor Account
TransferorAccount.definition: Identification of the account owned by the investor at the old plan manager (account servicer).

NomineeAccount.name: Nominee Account
NomineeAccount.definition: Account held in the name of a party that is not the name of the beneficial owner of the shares.

Transferee.name: Transferee
Transferee.definition: Identification of the institution to which the financial instrument is to be transferred. This may also be known as the new plan manager.

ProductTransfer.name: Product Transfer
ProductTransfer.definition: Information about the portfolio and assets.

MarketPracticeVersion.name: Market Practice Version
MarketPracticeVersion.definition: Identifies the market practice to which the message conforms.

Extension.name: Extension
Extension.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.

NomineeAccountServicerRule.definition: NomineeAccount/Servicer must be present when and only when different from TransferorAccount/Servicer.

Investor1Rule.definition: If PrimaryIndividualInvestor is not present, then SecondaryIndividualInvestor is not allowed.|If PrimaryIndividualInvestor is present, then SecondaryIndividualInvestor may be present.

Investor2Rule.definition: If PrimaryIndividualInvestor is not present, then OtherIndividualInvestor is not allowed. |If PrimaryIndividualInvestor is present, then OtherIndividualInvestor may be present.

Corporate2Rule.definition: If PrimaryCorporateInvestor is not present, then OtherCorporateInvestor is not allowed.|If PrimaryCorporateInvestor is present, then OtherCorporateInvestor may be present.

Corporate1Rule.definition: If PrimaryCorporateInvestor is not present, then SecondaryCorporateInvestor is not allowed.|If PrimaryCorporateInvestor is present, then SecondaryCorporateInvestor may be present.
